verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page claims Google and Outlook calendar integration (docs-25), and on-call schedules can live in a shared Google calendar (docs-49). Neither statement confirms a per-user subscribable feed that pushes my own shifts into my personal calendar. docs-49 describes the calendar as a schedule source rather than an export. missing for 10: explicit personal iCal/ICS feed of my shifts, documentation of sync direction and update behavior, setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
